intent: Replace the small-machine extrusion table architecture before repricing or shopping.
frame: All primary structural extrusion is 4080. Six posts; the two rear posts bear directly on short rear footbase beams. Eight feet extend the support polygon rearward. Main horizontal beams use their strong axis vertically; short ledger arms lie flat.
excluded_capability: This lightweight wood/plasma variant is not qualified for steel milling.
owned_excluded_from_procurement: electronics enclosure (user reconfirmed; model not reselected)
one nominal 304.8 x 304.8 x 12.7 mm aluminum blank
one nominal 304.8 x 304.8 x 9.525 mm aluminum blank
selected_reservoir_candidate: Amazon ASIN B0HN3Q77HR, red 20-gallon polypropylene storage tote with clear lid. User selected it for drain water, not electronics. Use conservative 712 x 470 x 389 mm external fit envelope. Liquid load/temperature, usable volume and lid plumbing remain verification holds; keep atmospheric venting.
conversion: Removable dry cassettes stay within the machine plan footprint during storage and the modeled transfer. No forward parking cart.
workholding: Aluminum T-slot tracks on dry cassettes, metal locating features and independent hold-down clamps. Track section and hole pattern remain supplier interface holds.
billet_preference: Keep the two gantry end brackets and six compact clevis mounts as integral billet parts for stiffness/alignment. Retain practical plate construction for the frame, actuator saddles and Y-link supports. Deep billets are new material unless physically confirmed owned.
water: Atmospheric pan and vented receiver; gravity drain is the baseline. No pressurization of a fabricated tank. Owned CV-15HS is a vacuum generator, not a liquid-transfer pump.
accepted_atc_requirement: Removable retractable ATC on an approximately 200 mm slide remains requested. XR1 does not yet integrate or qualify the exact magazine/slide. See ATC-INTERFACE.md; do not call this an ATC-complete machine or silently exclude unowned ATC hardware from a future whole-build total.

structure.scope: Frame, supporting ledgers and dry bed only. Actual tool-to-work error also includes owned gantry, rails, actuators, joints, Z stack and tooling.
structure.section_property_requirement: Do not infer stiffness from 4080 external dimensions or decorative CAD grooves. Verify actual vendor section properties against params.py.

thermal: Only uncoated steel is exposed to the hot plasma zone. Remove dust and wood from the hot bay; closed sheet-metal storage requires a measured temperature acceptance test.
qualification_holds: Delivered module stroke, overall dimensions, mounting slots and screw lead; no assumed 10 mm lead
Exact guide seat, rail hole pattern, block height and alignment limits
Actual extrusion section, slot geometry, core holes and straightness
Actual cutter start circuit and electrically isolated CNC interface
Actual torch diameter, permitted grip, nozzle projection and cable bend radius
Tool projection, clamp height and usable cutting depth over the complete dry surface
Z retention at power loss and end stops
Exact ATC kit, slide, retained tools, spindle reverse capability and 100 mm Z clearance; prior ATC study used a different Z stack
Joint slip/pullout testing and assembled frame/tool-loop deflection
Cold-water drain/overflow test, leak test and protected-storage temperature test
release: Engineering development; no fabrication or CAM release until the listed physical interfaces and acceptance tests close.
